scores.problem_translated: Sitting causes your hip flexor muscles to shorten, which can lead to problems with your hip joints. Sitting for long periods can also cause problems with your back, especially if you consistently sit with poor posture or don't use an ergonomically designed chair or workstation.
scores.solution_translated: A device like a watch ring or a bracelet that will give alerts.
scores.summarization: The problem is that prolonged sitting can shorten hip flexor muscles and cause back issues, especially with poor posture. The proposed solution is a device, such as a watch ring or bracelet, that provides alerts to encourage better posture or remind users to move.

scores.problem_translated: The Internet of Things (IoT) offers immense potential for transforming schools, homes, and public spaces by enhancing efficiency and automation. However, widespread adoption is limited due to barriers such as poor connectivity, high costs, privacy concerns, and a lack of technical knowledge. These challenges prevent communities from fully leveraging the benefits of IoT, leading to underutilization in education, home automation, and public services.
scores.solution_translated: Our solution focuses on making IoT more accessible by addressing barriers in cost, connectivity, and knowledge. We propose a community-driven IoT network, where local governments, schools, and businesses collaborate to install shared IoT infrastructure, such as public Wi-Fi hotspots and affordable smart devices. Schools will be equipped with low-cost IoT systems for energy management, and homes will receive simplified IoT kits with user-friendly interfaces. Additionally, we will offer training programs to teach users, especially students and families, how to use and secure IoT devices, addressing privacy concerns. This approach helps schools, families, and public spaces, bridging the digital divide and improving efficiency.
scores.summarization: The problem states that the potential of IoT is not fully realized due to issues like poor connectivity and high costs. The proposed solution is to create a community-driven IoT network with shared infrastructure and affordable devices, along with training programs to ensure proper use and privacy security for students and families.

scores.problem_translated: In our statistics, there are many problems in the atmosphere, with people, animals, etc.
scores.solution_translated: By advising people not to use plastic, cars, and waste water, and by forming teams to solve the problems.
scores.summarization: The problem involves various environmental issues affecting the atmosphere, people, and animals. The proposed solution is to educate people to avoid plastic, cars, and wasting water, and to work together in teams to address these challenges.

scores.problem_translated: Many delivery workers are having accidents due to mobile phones; our idea is to reduce these accidents.
scores.solution_translated: Next to my home, there is a worker who died due to talking on the phone while driving, which caused a lot of suffering for their parents. We want to solve this issue by creating a smart helmet.
scores.summarization: The problem is that delivery workers often have accidents because they use mobile phones while driving. The proposed solution is to create a smart helmet to help prevent these accidents.

scores.problem_translated: Modern farming methods use excessive water, which may ultimately lead to water shortages. The application of these techniques results in the eradication of essential microbes from the soil, which may eventually lead to soil infertility and unhealthy crops in the long run. Other issues include small and fragmented land holdings, lack of marketing and storage facilities, poor adoption of mechanization, available credit, poor irrigation facilities, soil fertility depletion, and inadequate access to crop insurance schemes. Precision farming, hydroponics, aquaponics, and vertical farming are just a few examples of modern farming methods gaining popularity among farmers. These methods increase efficiency, reduce waste, and provide a fresh and sustainable approach for consumers.
scores.solution_translated: Remember that Einstein was a very educated man who had just received his PhD. He would have been exposed to contemporary physics during his studies and he read journals and followed current research on the topic, discussing them with colleagues and friends. Therefore, he was already an expert in his field. However, his mind was so penetrating and original that, in many cases, he arrived at solutions even when he was unfamiliar with all the contemporary research and publications. The special theory of relativity is an example; Einstein was deeply influenced by some existing work.
scores.summarization: The problem outlines the challenges faced in modern farming, such as excessive water use, soil infertility, and inadequate facilities. It highlights the rising popularity of techniques like precision farming and hydroponics as efficient solutions to these problems. The solution discusses Einstein's approach to knowledge and problem-solving, emphasizing the value of deep understanding and original thought.

scores.problem_translated: In this generation, children are not studying in school because of the development of the internet, such as mobile phones and TVs. When children are interested in education, society develops.
scores.solution_translated: Quality education ensures inclusive, equitable learning opportunities that empower individuals with the knowledge and skills needed for lifelong success. Education technology makes education more accessible, engaging, and personalized. Technology, such as ICT (Information and Communication Technology) tools, serves as enablers for better teaching and learning outcomes in any kind of classroom, whether in-person, smart classroom, or hybrid remote classroom. It empowers students to skillfully navigate the complexities of society, unlocking their limitless potential to lead and drive our nation forward towards unparalleled progress and prosperity. Technology simplifies tasks for students regarding access to various educational materials; instructors can post their course materials or important information on a course website, allowing students to study at their preferred time and location and quickly obtain study material.
scores.summarization: The problem highlights that children are not studying in school due to distractions from technology like mobile phones and TVs. The solution proposes using quality education and technology to provide accessible and engaging learning opportunities, enabling students to manage their studies more effectively and reach their full potential.

scores.problem_translated: This project 'Carbon Purification' is primarily used in factories. It provides oxygen from carbon dioxide released from factories. The whole world is affected by this issue.
scores.solution_translated: It purifies oxygen from carbon dioxide released from factories. An absorbing unit captures waste gases from the factories and sends these gases into a purifying unit. In this unit, large carbon pieces are processed using high voltage electricity to absorb carbon when air passes through. The purified air is then released from the factory into the environment.
scores.summarization: The project addresses the issue of carbon dioxide emissions from factories, which affect the entire world. It proposes a system that purifies oxygen by capturing waste gases and using high voltage electricity to absorb carbon, releasing purified air into the environment.

scores.solution_translated: We will identify such problems and work to solve them by considering their issues in schools, hospitals, and other community areas.
scores.summarization: The student highlights the need for basic development in rural areas due to a lack of essential infrastructure. Their solution involves identifying and addressing various problems in schools, hospitals, and communities.

scores.problem_translated: Emphasizing the inseparability of the social, economic, and environmental dimensions of sustainable development, inclusive policies and practices at global, national, and local levels have been advocated within the sustainable development goals. Despite their non-binding nature, the sustainable development goals have influenced global debates, policy agendas, and institutional priorities, although transformative change has been limited. Collaborative financing, technological innovation, and strong global partnerships are essential to achieving these ambitious goals by 2030.
scores.solution_translated:
The 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development is referred to as a comprehensive plan of action for people, the planet, and prosperity. It directly relates to the three pillars of sustainable development: social, environmental, and economic. It consists of 17 goals, 168 targets, and more than 230 indicators to measure progress. The goals are a blueprint for achieving a better and more sustainable future for all. They address global challenges such as poverty, inequality, climate change, environmental degradation, peace, and justice.

The past few years have been like a bad dream for the entire world. Particularly, COVID-19 has acted like an X-ray revealing cracks in the skeletons of our society. It has made us realize that the path we were on was not leading us anywhere; we need to change our course. One thing is certain: we need to act now, and as Winston Churchill once said, "Never let a crisis go to waste," and this also applies to the 2030 Agenda. We need immediate action now.
scores.summarization: The student highlights the importance of integrating social, economic, and environmental aspects in sustainable development goals. They stress that despite limited transformative change, collaborative efforts and innovation are crucial to achieve these goals by 2030. The COVID-19 pandemic has exposed societal weaknesses, underscoring the urgent need for immediate action to create a sustainable and just future.

scores.problem_translated: A person next to our house, whose son works outside, sent some money online to his father for his sister's wedding. However, a cyber fraudster withdrew the entire amount from his father's account.
scores.solution_translated: Suggestions for online security: 1. Do not click on unknown links: Avoid clicking on links in emails or messages from unknown sources. These links can install malware on your device or steal your personal information. 2. Do not share personal information: Do not share your personal information, such as your bank account number, credit card number, or password, with anyone. 3. Use secure websites: When making online transactions, ensure you are on a secure website. Look for 'https' in the website's URL and a lock icon. 4. Keep passwords strong: Use strong and unique passwords for your online accounts. It is also a good idea to change your passwords regularly. 5. Monitor online transactions: Keep an eye on your bank accounts and credit card accounts, and immediately report any unusual or suspicious activity to your bank or credit card company.
scores.summarization: A neighbor's son was a victim of cyber fraud, losing money sent for a wedding. The proposed solutions include not clicking on unknown links, protecting personal information, using secure websites, maintaining strong passwords, and monitoring transactions.

Parents should guide their children to study according to their interests. 3. Children should be taught to use the internet responsibly. 4. Children below the poverty line should be provided free internet service. 5. The rates for mobile recharges should be reduced.
scores.summarization: The submission addresses network and economic issues faced by students in rural areas, including limited access to multimedia mobiles and the misuse of the internet. Proposed solutions include installing new network towers, providing free internet services to underprivileged children, and educating responsible internet usage.

scores.problem_translated: The development of glasses for visually impaired individuals is an important technological step. These glasses use ultrasonic sensors to help them accurately assess objects around them, especially in situations where vision is limited. With the help of ultrasonic sensors, these glasses understand the environment using sound waves and inform the user about the position and distance of objects in real-time. Ultrasonic sensors utilize high-frequency sound waves, and when these waves hit an object, they bounce back and the sensor measures this; this information can be conveyed to the user in various ways such as vibrations, sound signals, or a combination of both.
scores.solution_translated: Using ultrasonic sensors to create glasses for blind individuals can be an advanced solution. These glasses can combine ultrasonic and infrared technologies, allowing users to receive information about nearby objects. The ultrasonic sensors notify the user through sound or vibrations. These glasses could be extremely beneficial for blind individuals as they alert them to obstacles such as walls, stools, tables, or moving vehicles. Additionally, they assist in guiding them along roads to reach their destinations and help avoid obstacles along the way.
scores.summarization: The submission addresses the need for glasses using ultrasonic sensors to assist visually impaired individuals in navigating their surroundings. The proposed glasses use a combination of ultrasonic and infrared technologies to inform users about nearby obstacles, enhancing their ability to walk safely and independently.

scores.problem_translated: We often see around us that in summers, the tank water becomes hot, and in winters, the tank water becomes cold due to excessive heat in summers and extreme cold in winters.
scores.solution_translated: By wrapping a jute sack around the water tank and applying a paste of calcium (hydroxide) lime and mud on top, the temperature of the water will not decrease or increase, thus keeping the temperature of the tank water stable.
scores.summarization: The problem is that water tanks become too hot in summer and too cold in winter. The proposed solution is to wrap the tank with a jute sack and cover it with a mixture of calcium lime and mud to maintain a stable water temperature.

scores.problem_translated: In our village, there is this problem.
scores.solution_translated: A solution to the increasing thefts in houses or banks is proposed. It is an idea that automatically alerts the police about a theft happening in a house through a 'sensor'. A 'laser' beam is directed onto an 'LDR' (Light Dependent Resistor). If the laser beam is interrupted, the police will receive an alarm sound. This would occur when a thief enters the house; the thief would have to step on the place where the laser beam originates, triggering the alarm. After that, police officers can catch the thief. This system should be installed in houses and banks everywhere.
scores.summarization: The problem identified is the rise in thefts in houses and banks. The proposed solution involves a sensor system that uses a laser beam and LDR to alert the police when the beam is interrupted by a thief, allowing for quick response and capture.

scores.problem_translated: Threat intelligence-driven adversary emulation to assess your security monitoring capabilities and incident response procedures.
scores.solution_translated: Cybersecurity is the practice of protecting devices and services connected to the internet from online attacks. It involves using technologies, processes, and controls to reduce the risks of cyber attacks, breaches of networks, and unauthorized exploitation of technologies. Cybersecurity protects against phishing schemes, ransomware attacks, identity theft, data breaches, and financial losses. Some types of cybersecurity include: Network security: it protects the integrity and confidentiality of data being transmitted across networks. This includes firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and virtual private networks (VPNs). Cloud security: it protects cloud-based systems including data, applications, and infrastructure. Application security: it ensures software and devices are free from threats.
scores.summarization: The problem focuses on assessing security monitoring and incident response capabilities through threat intelligence-driven emulation. The proposed solution is a comprehensive approach to cybersecurity that includes network, cloud, and application security to protect against various online threats.

scores.problem_translated: The discussion on how to improve agricultural yields of the chapter 'Vilaikkam Noorumeeni' from the seventh-grade science textbook inspired this project. Trees in forests grow well without adding fertilizer. If we grow trees in our homes, we can achieve better results. If we apply the unique characteristics of forests to household plants, we can grow healthy plants and increase better yields. Adding fertilizer to plants like coconuts damages their roots. Therefore, the fertilizer application does not benefit the plants adequately, leading to decreased yields. In forests, fertilizer application does not happen through root cutting. If done correctly, it can enhance production in local plants.
scores.solution_translated: If the method of planting trees like those in forests is implemented in local areas, it will yield more crops. A forestation plan based on the Japanese model 'Miyo Waki' can be executed in a small area. It was understood through an interview with an agricultural officer that this new method benefits soil moisture retention, improves soil quality, and reduces competition among plants. Awareness classes were organized to educate people on the importance of forest conservation and preservation.
scores.summarization: The project seeks to improve agricultural yields by applying forest growth techniques to local plants, particularly by using the Japanese 'Miyo Waki' method for forestation. This approach aims to enhance soil health and moisture retention, leading to better crop production while raising awareness about forest conservation.

scores.problem_translated: Landslides are a type of natural disaster that cause significant damage to human lives and property. These disasters are very difficult to predict in advance. However, the aim of this project is to design a system using Arduino UNO with sensors, particularly a vibration sensor and soil moisture sensor, to detect the likelihood of landslides and send SMS alerts via a GSM module. This will help provide warnings before landslides occur, ensuring higher safety for local emergency responses.
scores.solution_translated:
The solution we have developed is a landslide warning system based on Arduino UNO. It operates using GSM module, vibration sensor, and soil moisture sensor. The working method involves the vibration sensor detecting signs of landslides, which the Arduino UNO processes. The soil moisture sensor detects the moisture content of the soil, and then it sends an SMS via the GSM module.

It helps:

- Local communities: If the likelihood of a landslide is known in advance, people can move to safer locations.
- Emergency services: Rescue workers receive real-time messages, enabling them to act quickly.

Benefits of the solution:

- Early detection of landslides, preventing losses.
- Enhanced safety for local communities and rapid response capability for emergency services.
scores.summarization: The student proposes a landslide warning system that uses Arduino UNO, a vibration sensor, and a soil moisture sensor to detect the risk of landslides. The system sends SMS alerts through a GSM module to help local communities evacuate and to assist emergency services with timely information, aiming for enhanced safety and reduced losses.

scores.problem_translated: A new model is needed for processing organic waste in schools. The current methods being used are not entirely effective. There are issues with pests and insects.
scores.solution_translated: Set up a kitchen garden. Create five holes of 30cm x 30cm x 30cm among the plants in the garden. Every day, deposit the organic waste in a net box raised above the ground level in the garden. The next day, place the waste in one of the holes and cover it with 2cm of soil. Once one hole is full, move to the next hole. When all the holes are filled, use the organic fertilizer from the first hole for the plants. Repeat the process.
scores.summarization: The student identifies the need for a new method to process organic waste in schools due to ineffectiveness of current methods and pest issues. The proposed solution involves creating a kitchen garden and systematically burying organic waste to produce fertilizer for the plants.

scores.problem_translated: In the busy life, a magic crib would be very helpful for mothers.
scores.solution_translated: A woman is busy with her household duties from the moment she wakes up in the morning. She often prioritizes her children's and husband's needs over her own. When she has a small child, her struggles become even greater. For mothers who think they can finish household tasks after putting the child to sleep, it is a challenge when the child suddenly wakes up in the middle of sleep. This is a significant obstacle to their work. Here is where our magic crib becomes important. When a child wakes up suddenly and cries during sleep, the magic crib will rock by itself, helping the child to sleep again. This is very helpful for mothers, as our magic crib assists in reducing their mental stress, even if only slightly.
scores.summarization: The problem is that mothers face challenges managing household duties while caring for small children, especially when kids wake unexpectedly during sleep. The proposed solution is a magic crib that rocks automatically when the child starts crying, allowing mothers to have a break and reduce their stress.

scores.summarization: The problem highlights the theft of expensive materials like copper and aluminum from grids, which still occurs despite security guards. The proposed solution is a system using mirrors and a laser light to trigger an alarm when unauthorized movement is detected, ensuring better security.

scores.problem_translated: The 'Bus Safety System: Protecting Kids & Pedestrians' is an innovative solution designed to enhance safety around buses, particularly for children and other pedestrians who might be at risk when a bus is stationary. This system addresses a critical safety issue: when a bus is stopped, children or pedestrians may walk in front of the bus, potentially putting themselves in danger if the driver cannot see them. Our system utilizes simple yet effective technology to prevent such accidents and ensure a safer environment. When a bus stops, especially in areas where visibility is limited, children might walk in front of the bus without the driver's knowledge. This can lead to dangerous situations where the bus might accidentally move forward, potentially causing accidents. To address this problem, a reliable and responsive safety system is needed to alert both the driver and the pedestrians.
scores.solution_translated: Our solution is the 'Bus Safety System: Protecting Kids & Pedestrians,' which aims to enhance safety around stationary buses. It uses IR sensors mounted at the front of the bus to detect the presence of pedestrians. When a pedestrian is detected, the system activates a buzzer and a red visual light to alert the driver. Simultaneously, a playback module announces a pre-recorded message, 'Please move away from the front of the bus,' to notify pedestrians. Additionally, the system integrates with the bus’s control to prevent movement if a pedestrian is detected. This solution helps children, pedestrians, and drivers by providing clear, immediate alerts and preventing accidents. It ensures that pedestrians are aware of their proximity to the bus and prevents the bus from moving until the area is clear, thereby addressing visibility issues and enhancing overall safety.
scores.summarization: The proposed 'Bus Safety System: Protecting Kids & Pedestrians' tackles the danger of pedestrians walking in front of stationary buses, which can be risky if the driver isn't aware. It employs IR sensors to detect pedestrians and alerts the driver with a buzzer and lights, while also advising pedestrians through a recording to move away. The system prevents bus movement if pedestrians are nearby, improving safety for all.

scores.problem_translated: Natural Farming is a multilingual half-yearly publication by the National Centre for Organic and Natural Farming. Articles have indirect relevance to Natural Farming technology and its regulatory mechanisms, the development of packages of practices, success stories, news related to conferences, seminars, etc.
scores.solution_translated: Natural Farming can be defined as 'chemical-free farming and livestock-based.' Grounded in agro-ecology, it is a diversified farming system that integrates crops, trees, and livestock, allowing for the optimal use of functional biodiversity. Natural Farming promises to enhance farmers' income while providing many other benefits, such as restoring soil fertility, improving environmental health, and mitigating or reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Substantial increases in input costs have led to a decline in crop incomes over the years. The prices of urea, DAP, and potash have risen by 60% to 600% in the last decade. Although the per hectare real value of output for major crops has increased in recent years, the rise in input costs was much higher, resulting in reduced farm income. Moreover, the green revolution technology is now considered to be degrading the agro-ecosystem and diminishing economic returns for farmers. Several studies have shown that chemical fertilizers and pesticides have adverse effects.
scores.summarization: The submission discusses the publication 'Natural Farming' by the National Centre for Organic and Natural Farming, which covers topics related to Natural Farming technology. It proposes Natural Farming as a sustainable, chemical-free farming method that integrates various agricultural elements to enhance farmer incomes and restore environmental health, amidst rising input costs and challenges posed by conventional farming practices.

scores.problem_translated: Hydroponic farming can face a number of challenges, including: High setup cost: Setting up a hydroponic system can be expensive, especially for large-scale systems. Constant power supply: Hydroponic systems need electricity to run continuously. Maintenance and monitoring: Growers need to be vigilant to avoid component failure. Common problems: Some common problems include wilting, dead roots, system clogging, infestation, and nutrient deficiencies.
scores.solution_translated:
Problem: Wilting

It can be due to several factors such as less irrigation or high temperature, where the plant loses its rigidity, and leaves start drying. In our project, automatic mobile-controlled drip irrigation is used. This is managed from our house and can control thousands of hydroponic plants at one time.

Solution: You should let your roots dry between each irrigation cycle. A backup pump should always be handy if the operating one fails because the plants can wilt quickly without water supply.

Problem: Dead Roots

There are many reasons for dead roots, like high water temperature, very high or very low EC, overwatering in dense substrates, and others. Dead roots can also be a sign of root rot pathogens infecting the system.

Solution: First, you should remove the plants with dead roots and then regulate the water temperature accordingly to increase aeration. Regular cleaning and sanitization of the system can eliminate the pathogens.
scores.summarization: The submission discusses challenges in hydroponic farming, including high setup costs, constant power needs, and common issues like wilting and dead roots. Proposed solutions include the use of automatic mobile-controlled drip irrigation to manage plant watering and guidelines for maintaining root health through temperature regulation and system cleanliness.

scores.summarization: The school is experiencing a long-term shortage of drinking water because it does not have access to tap water and relies on buckets and tankers. A proposed solution is to collect water from natural springs and use a pump to supply it to the school and the local community, which could effectively resolve the water crisis.

Reliance on traditional irrigation methods often leads to inefficient water use in agriculture and gardening, resulting in plants receiving either too much or too little water. While solar-powered moisture sensors offer a promising solution for automating irrigation based on real-time soil moisture levels, several challenges hinder their effectiveness. These challenges include inconsistent solar energy supply, calibration issues, technical failures, and a lack of user understanding. Consequently, this results in poor plant health, resource wastage, economic loss, and environmental degradation. There is a pressing need to improve reliability and efficiency.

scores.problem_translated:
In industrial workshops, saw machines are commonly used for cutting materials. However, these machines pose significant safety risks for operators, with accidental hand injuries being a major concern. Traditional safety mechanisms like emergency stop buttons or protective guards may not respond quickly enough to prevent accidents.

The aim of this project is to design and implement a real-time safety system using an ultrasonic sensor and Arduino. If any object (such as the operator's hand) comes within 30 cm of the saw blade, the system will automatically stop the saw machine, thereby preventing potential injuries. Additionally, a manual emergency stop button will be integrated for extra safety. The motor will only resume operation once the object has moved beyond the specified safety distance.
scores.solution_translated:
Our solution is an automatic safety system that stops the saw motor when any object or hand comes within 30 cm of the blade. This system is built using an ultrasonic sensor (HC-SR04), Arduino UNO, and a relay module that controls a 5V DC motor simulating the saw blade. Additionally, an emergency stop button provides manual control for immediate shutdown.

### How the solution works:
1. **Object Detection:** If the operator's hand comes within 30 cm, the waves bounce back, and the Arduino calculates that if the distance is less than 30 cm, it will trigger the relay module to turn off the motor. 
2. **Automatic Motor Control:** If no hand is detected within 30 cm, the motor runs normally.
3. **Emergency Stop Button:** 

### Who the solution helps:
1. Machine operators:
2. Workshop managers and supervisors:
3. Company owners:

### How the solution addresses the problem:
Accident prevention: Automatic control: Minimum downtime: Better safety.
scores.summarization: The problem identified is the safety risks posed by saw machines in workshops, particularly accidental hand injuries. The proposed solution is an automatic safety system using an ultrasonic sensor and Arduino that stops the motor if an object comes within 30 cm of the blade, along with a manual emergency stop button for added safety.

scores.problem_translated: When using a gas cylinder, it is not possible to know the amount of gas left in the cylinder, and it is also difficult to detect if there is a gas leak.
scores.solution_translated: This product is designed to easily identify the amount of gas remaining in the cylinder and to detect any leaks. The working method of the product is as follows: When the cylinder is placed on the load mount, the load cell beneath it sends pressure readings to the HX711 amplifier. From there, the data is sent to the Arduino Nano, which converts it into electrical signals and displays the amount of gas in the cylinder as a percentage on an LCD screen. Additionally, to easily detect any gas leak from the cylinder or stove, a gas sensor integrated into the device detects the gas and immediately creates a sound alarm and lights up an LED indicator, making it easy to know that there is a gas leak. This helps prevent potential accidents.
scores.summarization: The problem is that users cannot know how much gas is left in a gas cylinder or detect leaks. The solution is a device that displays the remaining gas percentage on an LCD and has a sensor that alerts users with sound and light if there is a gas leak, helping to prevent accidents.

scores.problem_translated: During the rainy season, farmers face difficulties in filling their grain sacks due to a lack of labor.
scores.solution_translated: 1. Take an old iron plate. 2. Cut iron plates into rectangle shapes and weld them as a base. 3. Weld another rectangle iron plate perpendicular to the base iron plate. 4. Weld iron rods to the horizontal iron plate. 5. Make an iron rectangular box for crane piling. 6. Weld hooks to hold the bag. 7. Add wheels to the model for moving purposes.
scores.summarization: Farmers struggle to fill their grain sacks during the rainy season due to a labor shortage. The proposed solution is to create a mechanical device using iron plates, rods, and wheels to assist in the process.

scores.problem_translated: A floating house is a means of protecting oneself during natural disasters. It is a type of dwelling that will be constructed using modern technology.
scores.solution_translated: Building Method: The floating house will be without a foundation. It will be constructed using buoyant materials. Types: 1. Temporary floating house 2. Permanent floating house. Benefits: 1. Quick construction 2. Reduced deforestation 3. Earthquake resistance 4. Eco-friendly 5. Easy transportation 6. Attractive design 7. Lower cost. Drawbacks: 1. Requires high maintenance 2. Risk of water pollution 3. Needs skilled labor 4. Vulnerable to climate change 5. Shorter lifespan. scores.problem_translated: In rural areas, agriculture-based irrigation is essential. We have encountered issues with borewell motors breaking down, which required us to rely on people for extraction. This was inconvenient for the community. To address this, we developed an electric-based mechanical machine. However, it did not work without electricity. Therefore, we created a device based on a cycle motor engine that allows us to extract the bore motor without needing electricity. We can start the motor engine whenever needed and lift the bore motor.
scores.solution_translated: Irrigation is vital for agriculture, and extracting water from borewells is necessary. Typically, we need to set up an electric motor for this purpose. When that electric motor fails, it must be extracted, and while there are many tools for extraction, they can only be used at specific times. Our solution is a device that uses a small cycle engine, which is mounted on three iron columns. When the cycle motor's engine is started, we can lift the motor using a belt with minimal fuel consumption and can operate it anytime. This does not require electricity or many people, making it an excellent tool for the community.
scores.summarization: The problem is that in rural areas, borewell motors often break down, requiring inconvenient manual extraction. The proposed solution is a cycle motor engine-based device that can lift the bore motor without the need for electricity or many people, allowing for easy and efficient water extraction anytime.

scores.problem_translated: Accidents were occurring due to the driver's negligence.
scores.solution_translated: We have built an automated wiper using a rain drop sensor and servo motor with an Arduino board and breadboard. It automatically starts functioning whenever rain or fog occurs without any need for manual operation, and it stops when the rain or fog ceases.
scores.summarization: The student's project addresses accidents caused by driver negligence due to weather conditions. They developed an automated wiper system that activates in rain or fog and stops when the weather clears, eliminating the need for manual intervention.

scores.problem_translated: Elderly or disabled individuals, or those who work outside for extended periods, do not have enough time to clean their homes.
scores.solution_translated: When a vacuum cleaner pipe is installed in a littered area, it draws the garbage inside.
scores.summarization: The problem is that elderly or disabled people and those working outside have little time to clean their homes. The proposed solution involves using a vacuum cleaner pipe to automatically collect garbage from dirty areas.

scores.problem_translated: When we see many people around us carrying heavy objects, it seems necessary to find a simple solution for this, resulting in the invention of the 'Jaggua Gadi' (a small cart).
scores.solution_translated: Every day at our school, when we serve lunch and snacks, we have seen some people struggle to carry those. Similarly, we have observed many people in the fields bringing agricultural materials. Therefore, we can create a small cart to easily transport any required items from one place to another.
scores.summarization: The problem is that many people struggle to carry heavy objects, especially in schools and fields. The proposed solution is to create a small cart that can help easily transport items from one location to another.

scores.problem_translated: Due to the negligence of gate men, vehicle accidents were occurring at railway crossings at all times, day and night.
scores.solution_translated: To create a self-operating railway gate, tools like IR sensors, servo motors, and Arduino boards were used. The self-driving railway gate automatically closes when a train approaches. We installed sensors some distance away from the railway gate which detect the train and close the gate. Once the train has completely crossed, another set of sensors will detect this and open the railway gate. This eliminates the need for gate men and operates at all times, reducing the chance of them falling asleep during night shifts. This model can also be adapted for use in parking gates and home gates. There was a problem when gate men fell asleep at night, and the financial burden of paying them fell on the government.
scores.summarization: The problem is that railway gate men sometimes cause accidents due to negligence, particularly at night. The proposed solution is a self-operating railway gate that uses sensors to close and open automatically when trains approach, eliminating the need for gate men and ensuring safety at all times.

scores.problem_translated: To clean up the waste in the middle of the lake or river and to prevent loss of human life if a person is used for this task.
scores.solution_translated: During a visit to a lake, we noticed that the middle part was very polluted. To remove the waste from this area, we designed a model. This Bluetooth-based boat is controlled by an Android phone, which connects via Bluetooth to another Android mobile phone attached to the robot. Once the Bluetooth connection is established, pressing any button on the mobile application sends the corresponding code to the other end of the Bluetooth module. The robot receives this code with the help of the paired Bluetooth. The received code is processed through a microcontroller via the Bluetooth module HC-05. The code number is sent to the microcontroller. The microcontroller is programmed to make decisions based on any input and outputs its decision to motor drivers that drive the motors to move forward or backward or turn, and to move the bin.
scores.summarization: The proposal addresses the issue of pollution in lakes and rivers that poses risks to human life. The solution is a Bluetooth-controlled boat operated by an Android phone, which removes waste from polluted areas by processing commands sent from the phone to control its movements.

scores.problem_translated: Due to lights burning during the daytime, electricity was being wasted.
scores.solution_translated: The main tools used to develop this model are IC LM555. When light rays fall on the LDR (Light Dependent Resistor), they create a blockade, increasing the electric resistance of the LDR. As a result, lights turn on when it is dark. When it gets dark, the LDR provides light, completing the circuit. Consequently, when there is light, the lights remain off, and they automatically turn on in the dark, avoiding wastage of electricity.
scores.summarization: The problem highlights electricity wastage due to lights being on during the day. The proposed solution involves using an IC LM555 and an LDR, which automatically turns lights on in the dark and off during the day, thereby conserving electricity.

scores.problem_translated: Directly irrigating the soil leads to plants experiencing higher stress due to variations in soil moisture, which results in reduced plant appearance. The lack of automated control in the system causes improper water management.
scores.solution_translated:
QSmart Irrigation...  
  
Smart irrigation helps solve several issues, including:  
  
Water wastage  
  
Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by providing the right amount of water to plants when needed. Traditional irrigation methods can waste up to 50% of water due to overwatering, evaporation, and inefficiencies.  
  
Crop yield  
  
Smart irrigation systems can improve crop yield and quality by providing adequate water to plants.  
  
Environmental protection  
  
Smart irrigation helps protect environmental systems and conserve water.
scores.summarization: The problem involves plants suffering from stress due to uneven soil moisture, which affects their appearance. The proposed solution is QSmart Irrigation, which minimizes water waste, enhances crop yield, and aids in environmental protection by delivering the right amount of water to plants.

scores.problem_translated: Loss of living beings
scores.solution_translated: Many living beings will be affected
scores.summarization: The problem concerns the loss of living beings. The proposed solution suggests that many living beings will be affected by this issue.

scores.problem_translated:
1. Unhygienic production conditions
2. Safe storage methods
3. Pollution

Unhygienic production conditions: In agricultural and food product manufacturing areas, sanitary conditions are often lacking.

Safe storage methods: When food items are not stored properly, they can be affected by contamination and dirt. Food safety decreases without regard to the duration of storage.

Pollution: The presence of pesticides, heavy metals, and similar chemical substances in food items can affect people's health.

Food fraud: When the authenticity of food products cannot be verified, people may consume spoiled or contaminated foods.

Food safety regulations: In many countries, food safety regulations or practices may be insufficient, making it difficult to obtain safe food.

Traditional agriculture: Agriculture that does not utilize herbs and traditional knowledge increases the risk of high pollution and dirt.
scores.solution_translated:
To address these problems:
1. Improving hygiene standards in agriculture and food production areas to ensure clean conditions.
2. Establishing proper food storage practices to prevent contamination and maintain food safety.
3. Implementing measures to reduce pollution from pesticides and heavy metals in food.
4. Creating systems to verify the authenticity of food products to prevent food fraud.
5. Strengthening food safety regulations to ensure safe food availability in all regions.
6. Promoting traditional agricultural practices that utilize local herbs and knowledge to reduce pollution and promote better hygiene.
scores.summarization: The submission highlights multiple issues regarding food safety, including unhygienic production conditions, improper food storage, and pollution from harmful substances. The proposed solutions involve improving hygiene standards, proper food storage, reducing pollution, verifying food authenticity, strengthening regulations, and promoting traditional agriculture practices.

scores.problem_translated: The use of LPG in rural areas has increased. However, there is not much awareness about it. As a result, children and the elderly often act carelessly while using LPG.
scores.solution_translated: The use of LPG in rural areas has increased, but awareness about it is still low. This leads to children and the elderly behaving carelessly when using LPG, such as forgetting to turn off the stove after use. As a result, LPG leaks can occur, leading to serious accidents and environmental damage. Therefore, we propose the idea of creating a sensor that automatically turns off LPG leaks as soon as they are detected.
scores.summarization: In rural areas, LPG usage is growing, but awareness is lacking, leading to careless behavior among children and the elderly. The proposed solution is to develop a sensor that can automatically turn off LPG in case of leaks, preventing accidents and environmental harm.

scores.problem_translated: The amount of water is decreasing.
scores.solution_translated: We can prevent this by increasing the quantity of water. It works well and helps everyone.
scores.summarization: The problem is that the amount of water is decreasing. The proposed solution is to increase the quantity of water, which is effective and beneficial for all.

scores.problem_translated: Many wild animals are found in the area, and during their migration, they can get caught in vehicles. This not only poses a danger to the animals but also disrupts vehicle drivers. The vehicles are affected by the sounds of the animals. Therefore, to protect wild animals, using reflectors on the bodies of these animals would be the best way to ensure they can cross roads without any harm.
scores.solution_translated: By using reflectors, wild animals will move away as soon as they detect vehicle sounds and lights.
scores.summarization: The problem highlights the danger wild animals face from vehicles during migration, which also disrupts drivers. The proposed solution is to use reflectors on animals to alert them of approaching vehicles, allowing them to move safely.

scores.problem_translated: We conducted a study by visiting students in the mountainous regions of Namakkal district, Kollimalai block, specifically in Nattukuzhipatti and nearby areas, under the Tamil Nadu government's school education department. We first carried out a survey with a questionnaire related to education and the problems they face. We then gathered some suggestions from their responses. Our study was structured to understand the various problems they encounter daily. Additionally, through this study, we sought to identify the daily challenges faced by students and find solutions for those issues.
scores.solution_translated: This project is designed to benefit students in 32 different ways. It is created in such a simple manner that even underprivileged students can easily build it using available materials at a very low cost. The items include: 1. WRITING TABLE 2. EXAM PAD 3. CHESS BOARD 4. LEAF FILE FOR PROJECT WORK 5. IMPORTANT FILES FOR CERTIFICATE PURSE 6. LED LIGHT WITHOUT ELECTRICITY OR IN LOW LIGHT 7. SMALL TABLE FAN 8. VEGETABLE CUTTING TOOL 9. LUNCHTIME DINING TABLE 10. FIRST AID BOX, etc. Overall, this project is designed in over 32 different ways to help students. It allows even underprivileged students to make it easily with low-cost materials. In the future, various modern technologies can be incorporated into this design and enhanced for government school students.
scores.summarization: The students identified daily challenges faced by their peers in the Namakkal district's mountainous areas through a survey. In response, they created a project that offers over 32 low-cost, easy-to-make solutions, such as writing tables and LED lights, that can be constructed using readily available materials.

scores.problem_translated: Due to global warming, there is a scarcity of water today. Everyone relies on piped water. Though there are good wells, they are getting covered. The reason is that it is not possible to clean the wells. Due to reduced airflow, it is dangerous. As a result, even villagers are covering the wells and depending on piped water. This will lead to a future situation where there will be no well water and no piped water either.
scores.solution_translated: This is a machine that can be used by workers to clean wells with a subsidy. It includes two ropes, a motor, a bucket, and a scoop to remove mud and waste. After the well water is drained by the motor, the worker lowers the machine from the bank. The motor in the machine is activated to scoop out the mud. Then, the scoop is slowly moved by the machine to deposit the mud and waste into the bucket attached to the second rope. After that, the motor is operated to pull the rope towards the bank, emptying the mud from the bucket, and the process continues. In this way, wells with no airflow can be cleaned safely. This can also be used to clean drains and other areas.
scores.summarization: The problem is that global warming has led to water scarcity, making people rely on piped water while wells remain covered and uncleanable. The proposed solution is a machine that helps workers clean wells safely, which can also be used for cleaning drains, ensuring access to clean water in the future.

scores.problem_translated: Every home, building, office, and industrial facility uses overhead water tanks, consuming a lot of water to fill them. However, many times we forget to turn off the pump after the tank is filled, causing water to overflow and leading to increased electricity usage.
scores.solution_translated:
*Water overflow is a problem that causes water wastage. By installing a water overflow alarm, we can prevent water from overflowing and going to waste.
*This can be used in water tanks, swimming pools, industrial processes, basements, and agricultural irrigation systems.
*It is easy to install, cost-effective, and safe.
*It will also help save electricity.
*It provides an audio-visual alert.
scores.summarization: The problem is that overhead water tanks often overflow because people forget to turn off the pumps, which leads to water wastage and increased electricity costs. The proposed solution is to install a water overflow alarm that alerts users when the tank is full, preventing overflow and saving water and electricity.

scores.problem_translated:
In schools, there is no proper method for the disposal of different types of waste. As a result, waste in schools and their surrounding areas is increasing rapidly. This is a common problem in all schools. The reason is that different types of waste management are not being conducted in schools, leading to a continuous increase in the amount of waste.

* Plastic waste
* Paper waste
* Food waste
* Chalk dust
* Rubber waste
* Iron waste
* Textile waste
* Ceramic waste

These are the main types of waste found in schools. The excessive increase of such waste adversely affects the environment of the school, the health of children, and also impacts our community. Burning these different wastes in schools causes harm to nature.
scores.solution_translated: We have developed this idea mainly to reduce the waste quantity in schools. Our proposal is to recycle different types of waste collected from schools in a useful way. For example, we can convert rubber waste obtained from schools into fuel, which can then be sold to create a good source of income. This will also help make our community free from waste. This problem affects school children, teachers, and others. Collecting plastic waste and turning it into new products provides us with a means of income through selling these products on a website, which can also increase our country's revenue. Additionally, we can manage the waste in our community. Furthermore, this can allow us to participate in the development activities of our country.
scores.summarization: Schools lack proper waste disposal methods, leading to an increase in various types of waste, which harms the environment and health. The proposed solution involves recycling waste, like converting rubber waste into fuel for sale, which can generate income and reduce community waste while supporting national development.

scores.problem_translated: Nutritional deficiency found in children
scores.solution_translated: Awareness - Educating about the necessity of nutrition and the diseases caused by deficiency. Providing balanced meals. Organizing 'Happy Dishes' once a week where children bring nutritious meals prepared at home and eat together under the guidance of teachers, who also participate.
scores.summarization: The problem is the nutritional deficiency observed in children. The proposed solution includes awareness programs about nutrition and diseases related to deficiency, alongside organizing weekly events where children share and enjoy nutritious meals together with teachers.

scores.problem_translated: We have created a prototype of an emergency light with a fan. During power outages, emergency lights are commonly used. A specific characteristic of the current weather is extreme heat. When there is no electricity, we can manage work and study with the help of the emergency light. However, due to the high temperature in the environment, we start to sweat, which affects its performance. To avoid this, we propose the idea of an emergency light with a fan. Since the light and fan are connected to two different switches, we can use the fan only when necessary, which helps in energy consumption. Developing such a device would benefit many people.
scores.solution_translated: This has been a problem in our lives. We thought about what solution could be found. Using the idea we had, we created a prototype with the help of our parents and teachers. It functions like a regular emergency light, but a small fan is connected to the back side of the light. These are connected with different switches. When there is a power outage, both the light and fan can work together. This allows us to work and study comfortably. If developed, this could greatly benefit the public.
scores.summarization: The student has proposed a prototype of an emergency light combined with a fan to address the discomfort caused by extreme heat during power outages. The device works like a regular emergency light but includes a fan that can be used separately, providing comfort for work and study.

scores.problem_translated: The world is facing an unprecedented energy crisis driven by climate change, environmental degradation, and the depletion of fossil fuel resources. As global energy demands continue to rise, it is essential to shift towards sustainable and renewable energy sources.
scores.solution_translated: The "Restore the Future of Energy" project aims to explore innovative solutions for transitioning to a sustainable, equitable, and energy-secure future. 1. Solar Windows: Solar energy windows for homes and schools. 2. Wind Turbines: Small turbines for installation in backyards. *How it works: 1. Renewable energy sources produce electricity. 2. Smart grids manage energy distribution. 3. Community engagement promotes energy conservation. *Who it helps: 1. Local communities: Access to reliable, clean energy. 2. Environment: Reduces greenhouse gas emissions. 3. Future generations: Sustainable energy legacy. *Benefits: 1. Renewable energy sources 2. Lower energy bills 3. Job creation
scores.summarization: The project addresses the global energy crisis by promoting a shift to renewable sources, specifically solar windows and small wind turbines. It aims to provide clean energy access to communities, reduce environmental impact, and create job opportunities.

scores.problem_translated: In all subjects, there are many lessons that have been difficult and confusing since the start of the small classes.
scores.solution_translated: This model is designed to help learn difficult lessons. To create this, we need two equal-sized cardboards, a cable, a battery, a buzzer, two pen bodies with screw connectors, chart paper, and a picture the size of the lesson to be studied. Stick white chart paper on top of the cardboard. On the first cardboard, write questions and connect a small screw to each question, while the second cardboard will have the part that needs to be studied attached. Then, connect them using a cable. Connect a screw to each pen body. On the back of the cardboard, the battery and buzzer should be connected, and the body of the pen with screws will touch between the question and answer. If the answer is correct, a sound will come from the buzzer; if it is wrong, there will be no sound. This way, we can learn in a very engaging manner.
scores.summarization: The problem is that many school lessons are difficult and confusing for students. The proposed solution is a learning model that involves a physical device where students answer questions, receiving feedback through sounds from a buzzer, making learning more engaging.

scores.problem_translated: In this era, when increasing traffic congestion and reduced availability of labor make waste disposal difficult, how can we implement a waste collection and easy transfer system through underground systems without affecting the lives of the public?
scores.solution_translated: After collecting waste from homes and apartments, it is deposited into a specially designed waste container. Once a certain amount of waste is gathered, a valve at the bottom of the container opens, allowing the waste to automatically transfer through a low-pressure pipe system to the nearest waste collection site. There, it can be sorted and recycled. Since this entire process is fully automated, it prevents waste from accumulating in one location, and avoids traffic issues caused by transporting waste on roads.
scores.summarization: The project addresses the challenge of waste disposal amidst traffic congestion and labor shortages. It proposes an automated waste collection system that transfers waste from containers to collection sites without disrupting public life or traffic.

scores.problem_translated: Solution for the quick depletion of EV charge: The charge gets depleted quickly. As a solution to prevent the vehicle from stopping during essential travel, connect another motor through a belt from the vehicle's motor. Connect its output to the charge point via DC. This way, while the vehicle is running, the power of the wind will charge the vehicle.
scores.solution_translated: Solution for the quick depletion of EV charge: The charge gets depleted quickly. As a solution to prevent the vehicle from stopping during essential travel, connect another motor through a belt from the vehicle's motor. Connect its output to the charge point via DC. This way, while the vehicle is running, the power of the wind will charge the vehicle.
scores.summarization: The proposal addresses the rapid depletion of electric vehicle (EV) charge. It suggests connecting another motor to the vehicle's motor using a belt and linking its output to a charging point to harness wind power while driving, thus charging the vehicle as it moves.

scores.problem_translated: The waste issue is most severely observed in urban areas. Waste management is one of the biggest problems faced by many cities today. The increasing population and the rise of industrial units will exacerbate the waste problem in the future. A sustainable solution to this is proper waste processing.
scores.solution_translated: Urban areas have a higher concentration of plastic pollution and water scarcity. Proper plastic recycling helps keep the city clean. 1. Utilizing solar energy in flats. 2. Reusing water. 3. Purifying plastic waste and providing it to processing units.
scores.summarization: The submission addresses the severe waste problem in urban areas, exacerbated by population growth and industrialization. The proposed solution includes proper plastic recycling, using solar energy in residential areas, reusing water, and purifying plastic waste for processing units.

scores.problem_translated: Identify the presence of invasive plant species and find solutions for the resulting environmental problems.
scores.solution_translated: Since invasive plants are biomass, instead of destroying them, we can extract natural fibers from them and convert them into products. We can produce brushes, mats, bags, and crafting materials. They can also be used to make organic fertilizers. Additionally, they can be utilized for resettlement. If invasive traits reach the seeds of agricultural crops (at the genomic level), it will increase crop yield. Controlled use will help increase the availability of agricultural land.
scores.summarization: The problem addresses the need to identify invasive plant species and the environmental issues they cause. The solution suggests converting these invasive plants into useful products, such as crafting materials and organic fertilizers, which could also enhance agricultural productivity.

scores.problem_translated: A day without electricity does not pass in our lives. However, we often face the issue of not having a reliable power supply every month. Installing solar panels in homes can be very expensive. This is a problem in itself.
scores.solution_translated: The water from the tank can be used to turn a generator, which then produces electricity. This electricity can be stored in an inverter. We can use this electricity whenever we need it. This way, we can manage the power shortages effectively. This will be beneficial especially for villages, schools, and hospitals.
scores.summarization: The student identifies the problem of unreliable electricity supply and high costs of solar panels. They propose using a water-powered generator to produce and store electricity in an inverter, which can be utilized as needed, benefiting villages, schools, and hospitals.

scores.problem_translated: Today, six-lane highways are being developed in our country. Vehicles are continuously moving at all times. A major issue that we often hear about is the energy crisis. Our idea is to bring a solution to the energy crisis along with these development activities. One of the primary reasons for the increase in energy demand is the growth of the population. This significantly affects energy consumption. The increase in demand for energy and the decrease in its availability lead to the energy crisis. We can partially address this by utilizing alternative energy sources.
scores.solution_translated: Through a self-sufficient highway line, electricity can be generated in three ways. Electricity can be generated using solar panels arranged on one side of the highway. A horizontal axis wind turbine is installed in the middle of the highway lines to generate electricity from the wind available when vehicles travel at a speed of 50 km/hr. Lastly, piezoelectricity can also be produced. Piezoelectricity generates electricity from the pressure applied to materials. By arranging piezoelectric components 5 cm below the road, it is possible to generate piezoelectricity as well.
scores.summarization: The problem is that rapid development and population growth in India are leading to an energy crisis due to increased energy demand and decreased availability. The proposed solution includes a self-sufficient highway that generates electricity using solar panels, wind turbines, and piezoelectric materials.
